scope: Asserted conceptual schema (TBox), not an ABox instance graph

nodes.label: AI Model
nodes.comment: Stress prediction model. Exists at different quality levels per continuum layer.

nodes.label: Accelerometer Sensor
nodes.comment: Determines user mobility and physical activity.

nodes.label: Adaptation Action
nodes.comment: Auditable action produced by an EvaluationState.

nodes.label: Artifact
nodes.comment: Versionable project artifact.

nodes.label: Authorization Decision
nodes.comment: Effective authorization obtained from the intersection of consent record, contract, zone and hard restrictions.

nodes.label: Buffer Record
nodes.comment: Temporary retained data record governed by authorization and storage policies.

nodes.label: Cloud Node
nodes.comment: Cloud continuum node for global processing. Selection is conditional on authorization and policies; it is not intrinsically preferred.

nodes.label: Community
nodes.comment: Group of users with similar mobility patterns and routines (neighbourhood, floor, hospital ward).

nodes.label: Computational Node
nodes.comment: Continuum architecture node capable of hosting models and processing data.

nodes.label: Consent Range
nodes.comment: Maximum processing scope declared by consent/contract. Includes LocalOnly, CommunityAgg, GlobalAgg and Denied/Revoked. Effective authorization is computed independently.

nodes.label: Consent Record
nodes.comment: User-declared consent decision independent from the semantic contract.

nodes.label: Data Category
nodes.comment: Semantic category of information governed by consent, privacy and transmission policies.

nodes.label: Data Context
nodes.comment: Operational context associated with data or a processing/transfer event.

nodes.label: Delegation Event
nodes.comment: Reified temporal delegation that records delegator node, delegate node, cause, validity interval and recovery condition.

nodes.label: EDA Sensor
nodes.comment: Electrodermal activity sensor.

nodes.label: Edge Node
nodes.comment: Edge continuum node. It is external to the local scope defined for raw physiological observations. Elasticity is a node capability, not a class invariant.

nodes.label: Evaluation State
nodes.comment: Derived by reasoning over NodeState + UserState + NodeUserRelation.

nodes.label: Federated Learning Session
nodes.comment: Event of parameter/model transfer between continuum layers (HFL).

nodes.label: Fog Node
nodes.comment: Fog continuum node for community/zone processing. Elasticity depends on deployment capability and is not fixed by the class.

nodes.label: Identifier
nodes.comment: Identifier that may be direct, pseudonymous or anonymous.

nodes.label: MAPE-K Symptom
nodes.comment: Symptom detected in the MAPE-K Monitor/Analyse phases and recorded for auditability.

nodes.label: Mist Node
nodes.comment: Closest node to the user. Minimal capacity, very low latency.

nodes.label: Mobile Device
nodes.comment: User smartphone acting as a personal Mist node. It belongs to the local processing scope when associated with the user.

nodes.label: Model Gradient Update
nodes.comment: Federated learning update that may leave a mobile device only after anonymization and noise addition.

nodes.label: Node-User Relation
nodes.comment: Captures distance and connectivity between a node and a user at a given instant.

nodes.label: Non-User
nodes.comment: Person in the environment without a wearable or active participation.

nodes.label: Parametrized Data
nodes.comment: Pre-computed and aggregated data. Raw physiological data never leaves the device.

nodes.label: Physiological Parametrized Data
nodes.comment: EDA, HR, SpO2, etc. Sent during the day or at night when conditions allow.

nodes.label: Policy
nodes.comment: Normative governance rule from POLICIES-REV-01. Policies are specifications, not execution mechanisms.

nodes.label: Processing Purpose
nodes.comment: Purpose for which data, model parameters or predictions are processed.

nodes.label: Replication Event
nodes.comment: Controlled and idempotent replication or synchronization event.

nodes.label: Restricted Zone
nodes.comment: Geographic zone with hard restrictions on external processing/transfer. Raw physiological observations remain on wearable/mobile or authorised personal Mist; Edge, Fog and Cloud are external to local scope.

nodes.label: Rural Zone
nodes.comment: Few nodes. Predominance of local retention and controlled transmission.

nodes.label: Semantic Contract
nodes.comment: Temporal agreement binding user, processing purpose(s), consent range and governing policies. It is independent from the user-declared ConsentRecord.

nodes.label: Service
nodes.comment: Stress prediction or any other continuum service.

nodes.label: Sleep Parametrized Data
nodes.comment: Sleep quality and phase durations. Generated when the user wakes up.

nodes.label: Sleep Sensor
nodes.comment: Captures total duration, phases (REM, deep, light) and sleep quality.

nodes.label: SpO2 Sensor
nodes.comment: Blood oxygen saturation sensor.

nodes.label: State
nodes.comment: Dynamic state of an entity; temporal and distinguishable from instantaneous observations.

nodes.label: Stress Observation
nodes.comment: Output of the stress prediction model.

nodes.label: Skin Temperature Sensor
nodes.comment: Skin temperature — used as stress indicator.

nodes.label: Temporal Entity
nodes.comment: Entity with an explicit validity interval. validTo denotes effective closure, never merely planned expiry.

nodes.label: Traffic Window
nodes.comment: Time interval with high demand (morning: wake-up; night: physiological data upload).

nodes.label: Transfer Event
nodes.comment: Auditable transfer of data, model updates or other payloads.

nodes.label: Trust Assessment
nodes.comment: Versioned assessment explaining a trust score.

nodes.label: Urban Environment
nodes.comment: Geographic and density context that conditions system connectivity and behaviour.

nodes.label: Urban Zone
nodes.comment: High node and user density. More communication options.

nodes.label: User
nodes.comment: System participant with a wearable device.

nodes.label: Wearable
nodes.comment: Personal IoT device (smartwatch, smart ring, smart band).

nodes.label: Zone type
nodes.comment: A zone classification referenced by policies. UrbanZone, RuralZone and RestrictedZone are both OWL classes and named ZoneType individuals; OWL 2 DL treats their class and individual interpretations separately.

nodes.label: applies policy
nodes.comment: Deprecated in v3.0.0; use ex:appliedPolicy. Use appliedPolicy

nodes.label: continuum level
nodes.comment: Physical/logical continuum level only; not a preference or quality ranking.

nodes.label: delegates requests to
nodes.comment: Used when a node is saturated or disconnected. For temporal delegation, use an ex:DelegationEvent with ex:validFrom/ex:validTo and ex:delegatedBy.

nodes.label: derived from
nodes.comment: SOSA observation that originated this state and provides its timestamp.

nodes.label: expires on recovery of
nodes.comment: Use semantic RecoveryCondition together with validTo/plannedExpiry.

nodes.label: governed by
nodes.comment: Links users, nodes, services, zones or sessions to the applicable policy according to location and processing context.

nodes.label: has AHP / multicriteria score
nodes.comment: Score of a specific candidate alternative. For AHP it is the AHP result; for other methods the DecisionMethod identifies the scoring semantics.

nodes.label: has active consent range
nodes.comment: Current user-declared range resolved from the active ConsentRecord. It is intentionally independent from the SemanticContract so inconsistencies can be detected.

nodes.label: has neighbor node
nodes.comment: Adjacent node to which requests can be delegated.

nodes.label: has policy action
nodes.comment: Policy action is now described by the normative policy statement and linked mechanisms/actions; retained only for compatibility.

nodes.label: has privacy budget
nodes.comment: Differential privacy epsilon value for the FL session.

nodes.label: has trust score
nodes.comment: Normalized historical reliability score [0,1]. A v3-compliant scientific use should also reference TrustAssessment with rule version and historical window.

nodes.label: has external trust weight
nodes.comment: External trust criterion used to filter/order already eligible alternatives. It is not part of AHP weight normalization.

nodes.label: is preferred node
nodes.comment: Historical preferred node for this user based on zone and load.

nodes.label: is redundant
nodes.comment: Redundant or repetitive data — candidate for elimination to reduce traffic.

nodes.label: legacy decision score
nodes.comment: Legacy single winning score retained for provenance. It is not equivalent to v3 per-alternative scores.

nodes.label: noise level
nodes.comment: Magnitude of noise injected into gradients or model parameters before transfer.

nodes.label: planned expiry
nodes.comment: Planned deadline distinct from effective closure validTo.

nodes.label: requires consent range
nodes.comment: Minimum consent-aware processing scope required for an action, policy, model tier or FL session.

nodes.label: selected model tier
nodes.comment: Model tier selected by the AHP-style decision balance.

nodes.label: state duration
nodes.comment: Computed as validTo - validFrom.

nodes.label: user feedback score
nodes.comment: User rating of the previous day's prediction (local model without consent).

nodes.label: uses model
nodes.comment: Model used by a service. Distinct from hostsModel, whose subject is a ComputationalNode.

nodes.label: valid from
nodes.comment: Effective start timestamp of a temporal entity.

nodes.label: valid to
nodes.comment: Effective closure timestamp. It must not be used for a planned expiration before actual closure.

properties.label: has consent range
properties.domain_text: (ex:User OR ex:SemanticContract OR ex:Policy OR ex:FederatedLearningSession OR ex:EvaluationState)

properties.label: has processing purpose
properties.domain_text: (ex:SemanticContract OR ex:Policy OR ex:FederatedLearningSession OR ex:EvaluationState OR ex:Permission)

properties.label: requires consent range
properties.domain_text: (ex:Permission OR ex:Policy OR ex:Service OR ex:ServiceState OR ex:AIModel OR ex:FederatedLearningSession OR ex:EvaluationState)
